base_prompt:
SPRITE for a comedic 2D game, full body, transparent background (real alpha channel), no ground shadow, no glow, no text, ONE character, nothing cropped, centered, portrait about 2:3.
REDRAW the attached character (same character idea, outfit, colors, pose) in a completely DIFFERENT, much SIMPLER art style: FLAT 2D VECTOR / sticker style like a casual mobile game or a Flash cartoon. Strict rules: only flat solid color fills, NO gradients, NO glossy highlights, NO fabric wrinkles or texture detail, NO realistic anatomy or shading; at most ONE flat darker-tone shade shape per area; a thick, perfectly UNIFORM dark outline (same thickness everywhere); simple geometric shapes; large simple eyes with simple pupils; minimal details (a few key features only); chunky exaggerated cartoon proportions (big head, tiny hands with simple mitten-like fingers). It must look hand-made by a cartoonist, NOT like an AI render.

jobs.name: kid_good_a_flat
jobs.prompt: The good kid: keep the blue coat, red beanie with white pom-pom, red-and-white scarf, red mittens, brown boots, small golden halo, arms up and a huge happy smile.

jobs.name: goblin_a_flat
jobs.prompt: The goblin kid: green skin, huge pointy ears, yellow eyes, jagged grin, ragged brown tunic, hugging the stolen red gift.

jobs.name: thug_a_flat
jobs.prompt: The thug kid: red bandana and red mohawk, angry eyebrows, small fangs, gold chain, dark purple jacket, torn jeans, boots, nail bat on the shoulder. Make him child-sized chibi (about 3 heads tall) like a cute-but-mean little kid.

jobs.name: yeti_flat
jobs.prompt: The yeti: big white and pale-blue fluffy body drawn with simple scalloped fur edges, blue-grey face, yellow eyes with red pupils, big fangs, two blue horns, big fists. Simple and chunky.
